events.title: Devlog #4 - A Thousand Thanks!
events.summary: {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/46109255/ff3b1058032c9089d8e40a43ffa61d43073d9190.gif Not long ago, almost nobody knew about Just Dying. Today it has more than 1,000 wishlists, and behind every one of them is one of you. Thank you from the bottom of our hearts: after a year of solo development, this is huge. To celebrate we made this video: a whole horde lining up to spell the number... and then, as tradition demands, we set it on fire. What you made possible You wishlisted the game. Every single one counts,

events.title: Devlog #3 - Extract or Risk It?
events.summary: {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/46109255/7c94ef70671d59e2c22b59593f33151f132d0383.gif You just took down a stage boss. Your deck is battered, the loot is right there, and an exit is in front of you. Do you leave with what you carry, or go down to the next biome - more dangerous, better rewards? That question is the Incursion, the new mode you can try right now in the demo: an extraction deckbuilder roguelike, solo or in 1-4 player co-op. How an Incursion plays {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/46109255/cf728efc6b88473a0c6f

events.title: Devlog #2 - Fast and Furious
events.summary: This update is about performance: the demo loads much faster and runs smoothly on weak laptops and on the Steam Deck. Plus changes to Horde mode (difficulty instead of map, a tougher curve, Challenge Altar), and rebalanced runes. Highlights The demo flies on weak machines. We measured with a low-end integrated GPU (Vega 8 class) simulated on our PC: from about 30 FPS to 60 on Low, Medium and High. On Steam Deck, Low and Medium run at 60 FPS. events.title: Devlog #1 - The Abyss Goes 3D
events.summary: Our biggest update yet: the game moves to a 3D world, gets a brand-new UI, the Atlas becomes Nodes and every weapon effect is repainted. Highlights The world is 3D. Terrain, water, grass, props and enemies all move into a world with real depth. Same ink-and-cartoon look as always, but now everything has volume and casts a shadow. The arena is a floating island.
